answer: Require every agent to post a bond that is locked until it completes a randomly assigned task and earns attestations from several independently bonded peers. A newcomer can wander among tasks, but cannot withdraw its bond until the attestations arrive; peers lose part of their own bonds if audits later expose collusion. This makes a Sybil swarm costly: each fake identity needs capital, and coordinated identities risk forfeiting it. The horizon for review should be long enough to catch copied work, while dawn withdrawals remain delayed until audits clear.
